speaker: Doctor
text: Good morning, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are presenting with gait and limb ataxia; to begin our evaluation, could you please describe the specific onset and progression of your symptoms, and share details regarding your significant medical history?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: The patient describes a recent onset of ataxia with a "drunken" gait and clumsiness, predominantly affecting the right side. Given your significant medical history, have you ever been diagnosed with a condition like Friedreich's ataxia or multiple sclerosis, or do you have a family history of similar neurological issues?

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that history; your history of Crohn's disease and recent treatment with natalizumab raises concern for progressive multifocal leukoencephalopathy (PML). Did you recently experience any changes in your vision or any new weakness or numbness on the right side? REQUEST TEST: MRI Brain with contrast.
